# `cfmat.studio`

<!-- generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py; do not edit -->

Strategy Studio: one namespace for the Strategy Creator workflow (M12).

```text
``from cfmat import studio`` gives the rule language, strategy specs, the
template library, the trade-level backtester and the optimisers together. The
code lives in:

    cfmat.strategies.rules        rule language (``Evaluator``, ``register``)
    cfmat.strategies.spec         ``StrategySpec``
    cfmat.strategies.templates    ``TEMPLATES``
    cfmat.backtesting.rule_engine ``backtest``, ``BacktestResult``, ``signals``
    cfmat.backtesting.optimize    ``sweep``, ``coarse_to_fine``, ``walk_forward``, ``strategy_matrix``
```

| Name | Kind | Defined in | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `available_functions` | function | [`cfmat.strategies.rules`](strategies.md) | Every name the rule language accepts: functions, patterns and price fields. |
| `backtest` | function | [`cfmat.backtesting.rule_engine`](backtesting.md) | Run ``spec`` bar by bar. Returns daily returns (fraction of capital, with ``size`` × capital notional per position), positions and a trade list. |
| `BacktestResult` | class | [`cfmat.backtesting.rule_engine`](backtesting.md) | Outcome of a rule-engine backtest: daily returns, positions and the trade list. |
| `coarse_to_fine` | function | [`cfmat.backtesting.optimize`](backtesting.md) | Smarter search: test every other value of each parameter first, then only the neighbours of the ``top_k`` coarse winners. Returns (results, evaluations). |
| `Evaluator` | class | [`cfmat.strategies.rules`](strategies.md) | Evaluate rule strings against one set of bars, caching every sub-expression. |
| `expand_grid` | function | [`cfmat.backtesting.optimize`](backtesting.md) | Every combination of a parameter grid, as a list of dicts. |
| `register` | function | [`cfmat.strategies.rules`](strategies.md) | Add a function to the rule language: ``fn(bars, *args) -> Series``. |
| `signals` | function | [`cfmat.backtesting.rule_engine`](backtesting.md) | Evaluate the four rule lists (AND within each list) at every close. |
| `strategy_matrix` | function | [`cfmat.backtesting.optimize`](backtesting.md) | Backtest every strategy on every instrument (long format: one row per pair). |
| `StrategySpec` | class | [`cfmat.strategies.spec`](strategies.md) | A strategy as data: entry and exit rules, protective exits and parameters. |
| `sweep` | function | [`cfmat.backtesting.optimize`](backtesting.md) | Backtest every parameter combination; results sorted by Sharpe. |
| `templates` | function | [`cfmat.strategies.templates`](strategies.md) | Template strategies, optionally only one category. |
| `walk_forward` | function | [`cfmat.backtesting.optimize`](backtesting.md) | Re-optimise on each training window, trade the next test window. |

Constants: `FUNCTIONS`, `MAX_RULE_LENGTH`, `PRICE_FIELDS`, `TEMPLATES`.
